notes.title: PixelType v1.2.0.159
notes.content:
PixelType has been updated to v1.2.0.159.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42862856/241f7f371a84435a9772a91c976711bc4ffcf26f.png[/img]

[b]New Features：[/b]
[list]
[*] Bitmap embedding (EBLC/EBDT) is supported. Equal-sized bitmap data is automatically generated.
[*] Font version can be specified. This can be changed from the project settings.
[*] The warning screen for font output can be skipped.
[/list]

[b]Changes：[/b]
[list]
[*] The codepoint selection screen has been optimized to reduce spikes when scrolling.
[*] The project settings screen is now wider than before.
[*] A GASP table is generated.
[*] OS/2 table version has been changed to 1, and codepage information is embedded.
[/list]

[b]Fixes：[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed blank glyphs in "Try your font here" being displayed with a wrong width than the output font when using TrimAuto metrics.
[/list]

notes.title: PixelType v1.1.0.76
notes.content:
PixelType has been updated to v1.1.0.76.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42862856/777a7faa48e98c00f80ccaaba4025912921e890e.png[/img]

New features:
[list]
[*] [b]Automatic reloading of sheets. [/b] Updating an image file of a character sheet is now immediately reflected in PixelType. You can work while checking for changes.
[*] [b]Mapping tables. [/b]A table of encodings is now displayed in PixelType, allowing you to quickly select the desired code point.
[*] [b]Shift_JIS valid area limited mapping. [/b] A new mapping type has been added that skips areas where Shift_JIS characters do not exist, allowing for more efficient creation of 2-byte character sheets.
[*] Added full-screen switching button to the Start menu.
[/list]

Changes:
[list]
[*] When errors occur during project loading, saving, or exporting fonts, a message is now displayed.
[*] Glyphs in undefined areas on the mapping table is now excluded from exported fonts.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem in which Shift_JIS Windows extended areas were not mapped correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: PixelType v1.0.1.5
notes.content:
PixelType has been updated to v1.0.1.5.

 - Fixed a problem that Shift_JIS mapping could not be used.
 - Fixed a problem in which outlines for certain pixels were not created correctly.
 - Updated input system.
